reason: B0 from Owner-sealed governance; every entry's cited line re-read and verified

entries.requirement: A result is never PASS by surface resemblance, a good-looking capture, an isolated behaviour, a PC result or a partial Dolphin success; every run carries a fidelity assessment that is separate from the probe's own outcome letter.
entries.why: TB-FINISH 2026-10-19: the worker's probe letters (F3B 'A', F2A 'A') answered the probe's causal question, while the independent audit of the same captures read FAIL_VISUAL; reading the letter as fidelity hid four visual failures.

origin.quote: **Principio rector:** no declarar PASS por semejanza superficial, captura bonita, comportamiento aislado, resultado de PC ni éxito parcial en Dolphin.

entries.requirement: Every property is classified at exactly one evidence level (REFERENCE, DESIGNED, BUILT, LOADS IN DOLPHIN, WORKS IN DOLPHIN, VALIDATED ON WII, VISUALLY APPROVED) and the levels are never merged in a report.
entries.why: A feature that loads in Dolphin was reported alongside one approved by the Owner as if they were the same state.

origin.quote: **Regla de honestidad:** clasificar cada propiedad como REFERENCIA, DISEÑADO, CONSTRUIDO, CARGA EN DOLPHIN, FUNCIONA EN DOLPHIN, VALIDADO EN WII, APROBADO VISUALMENTE. No mezclar niveles de evidencia.

entries.requirement: Every authorised reference (image, render, capture) is registered with its SHA-256 before work starts and the original is never overwritten.
entries.why: Without a hash the thing a result is compared against can change under the comparison.

origin.quote: - **Reference Registry:** asset original, hash, propietario, región de interés, resolución, relación de aspecto, versión e interpretación. La fotografía/render original nunca se sobrescribe.

entries.requirement: Each asset has a feature contract that names its critical features, known unknowns, allowed deviation, required screenshots and behaviour, and its status.
entries.why: A contract is what makes 'looks like the reference' decidable instead of arguable.

entries.requirement: The Owner's sign-off on face, hair, torso, back, door and kitten is a recorded decision; automatic similarity never replaces it, and an agent never approves its own gate.
entries.why: Identity features are an artistic call that only the Owner makes.

origin.quote: - **Approvals:** owner sign-off por rostro, pelo, torso, espalda, puerta y gato; la similitud automática NO sustituye el visto bueno.

entries.requirement: Dolphin evidence names its profile (WII_EQUIVALENT or DOLPHIN_HD); DOLPHIN_HD is diagnostic only and is never a Wii criterion.
entries.why: An enhanced render hides defects the native console shows.

origin.quote: - Dos perfiles de Dolphin, uno **WII_EQUIVALENT** (nativa, sin mejoras visuales engañosas) y otro **DOLPHIN_HD** (solo diagnóstico/marketing, jamás criterio de Wii).

entries.requirement: WII_PASS requires physical-console evidence (video and logs); without it the highest state is a Dolphin state and the gate stays open.
entries.why: Dolphin on GEX44 is not real-Wii proof.

origin.quote: - Ensayos de hardware Wii física con vídeo y logs disponibles; sin esta evidencia no hay `WII_PASS`.
